backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no defined methods.
feature_evidence.json: JSON report listing implemented features, associated source files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the role of each frontend source file.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based stylesheet defining OKLCH color variables, dark mode themes, fonts, and animation keyframes.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell that loads the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Renders the ValentinePage component as the root application view.
frontend/src/components/Confetti.tsx: Generates animated falling heart confetti using randomized positions, delays, and rotations.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer showing copyright info and a caffeine.ai link with UTM tracking.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header with title, animated heart icon, and an audio toggle button with tooltip and error indication.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and refreshes a backend actor based on Internet Identity authentication state.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackgroundMusic.ts: Manages looping background music with autoplay recovery, gesture listeners, load readiness, error handling, and persisted enabled state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication and login state via Dfinity AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exposes a simple hook returning backend readiness based on actor loading, with no actual backend queries.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind layers, custom OKLCH theme variables, typography, dark mode values, and animation keyframes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it in React Query and InternetIdentityProvider before rendering.
frontend/src/pages/ValentinePage.tsx: Implements the main Valentine interaction flow with yes/no logic, animations, audio prompts, sharing, and celebration state.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, fonts, animations, plugins, and OKLCH‑based theme variables.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, requirements, known issues, and architectural notes for the Valentine site.
